scripts.db:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply sparqfire-preview --local --env preview
scripts.db:preview: wrangler d1 migrations apply sparqfire-preview --remote --env preview
scripts.db:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply sparqfire-production --remote --env production
scripts.deploy:preview: node ../../scripts/worker-config.mjs check preview && wrangler deploy --env preview
scripts.deploy:production: node ../../scripts/worker-config.mjs check production && wrangler deploy --env production
